subject: lion
title: A Three-Legged Lion Swam Over a Kilometre Through Crocodiles

scenes.text: A three-legged lion did something no lion had been filmed doing.
Jacob lost a leg to a poacher's trap. A buffalo once gored him.
One night in Uganda, he and his brother waded into a channel full of hippos and crocodiles.
Lions usually swim a hundred metres at most. Jacob swam more than a kilometre, on three legs.
A heat camera drone filmed it. The prize on the far side: lionesses.
There was a bridge, with armed guards. To Jacob, people were scarier than crocodiles.

description:
Two lion brothers in Uganda's Queen Elizabeth National Park swam across the Kazinga Channel at night, a crossing of more than a kilometre through water full of hippos and Nile crocodiles. One of them, Jacob, has only three legs after a poacher's trap.
Previously documented lion swims were only about 10 to 100 metres. A nearby bridge was guarded by people, so researchers think the lions chose the water to avoid humans.
Would you call Jacob brave or desperate?
first_comment: Jacob and his brother tried the crossing three times and turned back after meeting hippos or crocodiles before they made it. Would you have tried a fourth time?
